g.text: Failover mid-incident (scenario 8): the active controller is lost while its floor is released
cross-floor: doors of level0 + level2 released
PUT 46 doors closed_locked (relock hint covers the lost state)
30 s without the active's heartbeat → PROMOTED (acting=True)
keeps ticking on the same readings; doors untouched (never re-locked by a handover)
Deployment recreates the pod (21 s); empty state
